items.summary: Code injection (CWE-94) in SAP S/4HANA's Manage Substitution/Validation Rules: an authenticated attacker with specific business privileges submits crafted input that escapes the scripting language and executes as arbitrary ABAP code, leading to full system compromise.

iFlytek Astron Agent below 1.1.2: the default workflow code-node path uses an unsandboxed LocalExecutor, letting an authenticated low-privilege tenant run root Python in the core-workflow container and bypass tenant checks to read or modify other tenants' data.

Relative path traversal (CWE-23) in Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AMP File Reputation: a remote unauthenticated attacker sends a crafted email attachment, enabling arbitrary file write and root command execution with no user interaction. CISA KEV-listed Oct 14, 2026 with active exploitation confirmed.

Incorrect authorization (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source allows arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user with no user interaction; fixed in the October 2026 release train.
Improper control of code generation (CWE-94) in IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0/9.2.0 lets a remote attacker execute arbitrary code without authentication.
